name: Mixed debris (C&D)
note: Remodel and construction debris, furniture, general junk

name: Household cleanout
note: Bagged trash and cleanouts; landfill charges more than the C&D cell

name: Roofing shingles
note: About 1 t per 10 squares of one layer; 10 and 20 yd only

name: Yard waste and brush
note: Goes to the compost site, which is cheaper than the landfill

name: Clean concrete, brick, dirt
note: Fill to the halfway line; nothing mixed in, or it bills as mixed debris

name: Hazardous and liquids
note: Paint, oil, chemicals, batteries, asbestos. Refused at the gate
